statements.text: A perspective is the constrained opening to the world a creature has through its body, senses, situation, memory, drives and culture. A pure subject is a universal subject without such a perspective, whose experience is aperspectival and nondual. What remains of subjectivity without perspective is ipseity, selfhood as such: a conscious presence without form or objects, ready to become the recipient of objects.

sources.quote: A pure subject is an aperspectival subject, that is, a universal subject devoid of individual conscious perspective.
in the absence of perspective there remains ipseity, or selfhood as such
